title: Audit batch 2: six blank rounding, provenance and release acceptance documents
public_pr_body:
Adds exactly six short Markdown files under docs/audit/:

- G09 versioned nearest-penny halves-up specification, with negative ties away from zero, per-line VAT, display/payment/reconciliation scope and costing excluded. Links the pinned 38-case table and money-parity run 41904817337; Rhys’s signature stays blank.
- G07 change/impact record from 9c3f5c6 to an exact new delivery-note SHA (blank), covering release 147, day-of DLN counter, matching/replay fixes, reuse and rerun decisions.
- G18 Code’s artifact/profile (prod, realistic, x100)/checkout/exit/log-hash provenance template; profile labels do not authorise production or real data.
- SliQ source/destination counts and penny reconciliation certificate, exclusions, independent check and sign-off.
- Production restore acceptance report with backup/target/object comparisons, measured duration, accepted RPO/RTO and approvals.
- Final-SHA release impact/deviation log with recheck, closure and go/hold records.

All record forms include requirement ID, expected result, blank actual result marked NOT EXECUTED, evidence reference, tester, date and approval. No PASS entry or filled operational signature. Six concise templates, 388–463 words each; print layout must be checked before controlled issue. Existing rounding run is linked evidence, not approval of a new final SHA.

- [x] Source/links/required fields and git diff --check reviewed; remote/local trees match.
- [ ] John/Rhys/Code supplies exact versions, private evidence, assessments and approvals after actual work.
